summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/worker-6 re-review reconciled Table 1 peptide identities, Table 2 activity/toxicity values, linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows, supplementary Table S1, and mechanism figures/prose. The paper is publication-grade with explicit cautions for figure-only database low-hemolysis thresholds and non-tabulated mechanism quantification.
adjudication_summary: Accepted with cautions after bounded local source recovery. The previous framework-only rework target is closed because worker-4 row reconciliation and worker-6 final adjudication are now source-reviewed and gates have no open rework targets.

materials_exhausted.notes: All local materials relevant to the worker-4/6 blocker were opened. No external supplement chase was used; duplicate HTML .bin files and figure-only exact values are bounded cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 rechecked all 111 linked database rows. Table 1 and citation metadata support peptide identity/source linkage; Table 2 supports MIC/MBC/MBIC/MBEC/HC50/IC50 and CAMP/dbAMP summaries. Six duplicated low-hemolysis threshold database rows remain source_conflict because the exact threshold at fixed concentrations is figure-only, not tabulated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-6 final activity evidence replaces the framework candidate rows with 57 Table 2 source-located rows, preserving raw values, units, targets, endpoint types, and assay locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 final mechanism claims are bounded to direct membrane permeability, membrane depolarization, SEM/biofilm disruption, and structure-activity context. Exact figure numeric series are not invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_materials: OA package includes Table1.DOCX and image supplements. Table1.DOCX was parsed; duplicate landing-page .bin files were checked and do not add recoverable spreadsheet/PDF values.

caution_findings.note: Six linked database rows represent three unique DBAASP low-hemolysis threshold assertions duplicated across linked assay/experiment snapshots. Figure 4 is available locally, but no XML/PDF table gives exact threshold values at those concentrations, so they remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.

Temporin-FLa and Temporin-FLb are source-supported truncation derivatives; Table 1/Supplementary Table S1 underscore deleted residues, while final records separately preserve normalized sequence letters for comparison.

Table1.DOCX was parsed and supports derivative parameters. Ten staged supplementary .bin files were duplicate Frontiers article HTML landing pages; no local supplementary spreadsheet/PDF table changed Table 2 activity, toxicity, database, or mechanism adjudication.

Figures 6-8 support membrane permeability, depolarization, and biofilm disruption qualitatively/dose-responsively, but local materials do not provide exact figure numeric series; final mechanism claims avoid fabricated quantification.

packet_layer_note: Packet analysis artifacts were reopened as evidence; final publication-grade artifacts under papers/<paper_id>/final and packet/final carry the source-reviewed worker-6 adjudication.
